close_reason: Added LintClone supertrait to Lint (blanket-impl'd for every T: Lint + Clone + 'static; concrete Lint impls just need to derive Clone, which all already did) plus a Clone impl for Box<dyn Lint> that delegates to LintClone::clone_box. apply_parameter_overrides now uses clone-and-swap: it clones every affected lint into a BTreeMap, applies set_parameter on the clones, and swaps the clones into the registered slots ONLY after every override has succeeded. A mid-batch InvalidParameterOverride leaves the runner unchanged (preserving either the construction-time default or the most-recently-committed value, depending on prior apply history). The previously-documented 'short-circuit on first failure leaves runner partially mutated' caveat is removed; the rustdoc now documents the atomic-on-either-error-variant contract. Added #[derive(Clone)] on every concrete Lint test fixture (14 sites across pkix-lint, pkix-lint-cabf, pkix-policy-zlint) and to the crate-level doctest example. Three regression tests: apply_parameter_overrides_atomic_on_invalid_value_keeps_default (failed batch from defaults), apply_parameter_overrides_commits_on_full_success (positive control), apply_parameter_overrides_atomic_on_invalid_value_keeps_previous_commit (failed batch after a successful one preserves the previously-committed value). 271 lib tests + 7 doc tests + workspace tests pass; pkix-lint, pkix-lint-cabf, pkix-policy-zlint clippy --all-features --all-targets clean.
description: Site: lib.rs:1184-1214. Documented limitation: 'Errors short-circuit on the first failure — overrides applied before the failing one remain mutated on the lints. Callers that need atomic application should resolve and validate overrides against the catalog before installing the lints in a runner.' Scenario that triggers cost: an OSCAL Profile sets parameters for lints A, B, C. Lint A accepts its override. Lint B accepts its override. Lint C rejects its override. The runner is now in a state where A and B have the new values but C has the old value, AND the error propagated to the caller. Maintenance consequence: every caller has to either build a 'try first, install later' wrapper, or accept that a failed apply leaves the runner in a half-overridden state. The doc's suggested workaround ('resolve and validate against the catalog before installing') is wrong: catalog-level validation can't predict which set_parameter calls will succeed because the lint's set_parameter accepts/rejects based on the lint's own internal domain constraints, not on the catalog's declared parameter shape. Fix: clone lints, apply to clones, swap on success. Cost: one Box<dyn Lint> clone per registered lint; we don't have a Lint::clone() yet so this needs design work (typed-state lints could derive Clone, the Box<dyn Lint> trait object would need Box<dyn LintClone>). Tracking this as P1 because the workaround is non-obvious.
title: apply_parameter_overrides is non-atomic — partial application on failure
